correctness.rationale: The proof establishes exact valuation differences inside every input parity branch for odd exponents, two triangular-polynomial isometries at k=2, and four modulo-four branches for higher even exponents using the binary lifting identity. Each normalized branch induces permutations at every finite dyadic precision, hence is a 2-adic bijective isometry, making both full coset support and exact uniform finite fibers rigorous for all k,n. The separate n<h boundary and k=1 special case were checked. Direct independent enumeration and raw power differences passed 11256 finite checks; only the infinite valuation proof establishes unbounded cases.

originality.rationale: Targeted literature and mathematical-record searches, plus material inspection of the most relevant primary and published results, revealed no exact or stronger classification for the one-variable correlated map. The 2023 modular-Waring article and the 2026 unrestricted sum results allow two free input variables, whereas this result constrains the second to the first plus one. The 2017 Diophantine paper asks for integer perfect-power outputs rather than residue fibers. A latent special case of a general lifting theorem or an unindexed equivalent remains a nonzero priority risk.

value.rationale: Sums of adjacent equal powers form the most natural correlated two-variable restriction of modular Waring sums. Their complete dyadic image and exact target multiplicities, with the distinct odd/quadratic/higher-even regimes, answer a coherent local representation problem and determine a natural Haar output law. The result is a complete parametrized classification, not merely a numeric instance or an isolated trivial congruence.
